items.reason: The Google Meet fallback dereferences an undefined mainHostDestinationCalendar when the destination array is null or empty.
Calendar providers select the first destination for every host, causing other hosts' credentials to target the organizer's calendar. Passing a per-destination event fixes the same routing problem.
The update and delete fallbacks search for an absent externalCalendarId instead of using the configured destination calendar.
updateLocation rebuilds references from update results that lack externalId and credentialId, losing calendar and credential routing information.
Recurring collective cancellation repeatedly selects the first occurrence reference and organizer credentials, leaving co-host events undeleted.
The optional push discards co-host destinations when the organizer's destinationCalendar is null.
Video references lose their credentialId, preventing cancellation from finding the credential and deleting the external meeting.
